qualification_dependency: qualification-v3 must complete; a failed campaign cannot supply a successful selected-input inventory
inputs: Every distinct final selected input from all 22 representation buckets; exact genomes and recipe source hashes frozen before execution. No case filtering or parameter reduction.
operation: Construct the exact recipe and produce a certified closed rational enclosure whose absolute width is at most 2^-256.

matching_contract.hyperreal: Build one fresh Real per process; request each scheduled negative computable precision until the exact rational interval width meets the bound.
matching_contract.mpfr: Evaluate directed MPFR interval expressions from exact rational parameters at each scheduled significand precision until the exact rational endpoint width meets the same bound.
matching_contract.exhaustion: Explicit error; never silently lower accuracy or omit the case.

timed_scope: Exact expression construction, adaptive enclosure evaluation, native exact-rational endpoint extraction and width checking, and temporary/value destruction. Input JSON decoding, shared recipe-parameter decoding, process startup, output text encoding, independent correctness oracle and cleanup are outside the timer.
cold_contract: One measured backend operation in a fresh process. No oracle or numeric warmup before the timer. No claim that OS page or allocator caches are cold.
case_order: Seeded shuffle of all cases per repetition, seed 20261014; backend order alternates by repetition and canonical case index.
measurement: Native release build with serde, without dispatch-trace or sanitizers. Pin measurement descendants to one CPU from the allowed affinity mask and record the CPU and hardware.
correctness: Independently parse all exact endpoints, enforce absolute width, compare with the 1024-bit directed reference enclosure, and retain all answers/precision steps. This rejects contradictions; overlapping intervals do not prove arbitrary symbolic identities.
statistics: Retain all 11 samples; report per-input median, minimum, maximum and median ratio. No outlier removal, best-case substitution, retry, extension or pooled trials.
gates: Formatting and strict affected all-target Clippy feature configurations
Sanitizer example tests for native backend adapters and exact width handling
All declared final selected inputs measured at the same accuracy contract
All raw result records replayed and source/binary hashes checked
limits: This compares interval enclosure operations on selected scalar inputs; it does not compare structural certificate APIs or establish whole-library rankings.
No warm-result performance claim, cross-machine generalization or matched cross-library allocation claim.
Native GMP/MPFR code is not claimed ASan-instrumented.
Other stack layers, exhaustive coverage, formal obligations and complete P38 remain open.
